editorial:
Imagine coming home after a long day and finding a total stranger in your living room. That is exactly how things start for the couple in this story. At first, it feels like your typical home invasion movie where a thief just wants some cash and a quick getaway. You will feel for the couple as they try to stay calm and protect each other, but you will quickly realize that the intruder knows way more about them than he should. The vibe shifts from a simple robbery to a tense game of cat and mouse that keeps you guessing about who is actually the bad guy here.

What really makes this work is how the tension builds up without needing huge explosions or fancy effects. The acting feels real, and the twists hit hard because you never see them coming. While it starts a bit slow, the second half picks up speed and does not let go. If you enjoy movies that mess with your head, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you want the best picture quality, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the intruder is not a random thief at all. He is actually there to expose a dark secret the couple has been hiding. As the night ends, you find out the couple committed a terrible crime in the past. The intruder forces them to admit the truth before the police arrive. In the end, the couple is the one facing justice, proving that the real monsters were inside the house all along.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves twists and home invasion stories.
